# F200 metadata for the shared private-credit Library test

This directory supplies only Factorio2.0 metadata. Project its `info.json` together with `library-multiplayer/control.lua` and `library-multiplayer/settings-updates.lua`; do not pass this directory alone as a complete fixture or copy the F210 metadata into the F200 engine.

The frozen input record and `library-private-credits-current-f200-2077.json` select exact2.0.77/D3, currentE9, canonical723 observer and both F200 API-consumer projections. The existing governed multiplayer runner verifies the exact six-mod selection and every source/archive payload, preserves library controls, and uses two real EN/DE clients through initial join, rejoin and cold host restart.

The shared0.3 assertions check all four private IDs in All and External, disabled private actions, unchanged native holder/research/queue/effect state, positive ordinary-research controls and restored personal views. This fresh-world case does not qualify imported historical earnings, persisted private selections, foreign-hidden research, actual keyboard/drag input, retained memory or comparative speed. Preserve the original F210 inputs and results under their original refs.
